findings.description: Direct inspection of all five views and six poses shows the overskirt still reads as a smooth flared shell; the six sewn pleats are not legible at product-view scale. Astra review independently concurs.

Matching waistband and upper-skirt radial clearance to the bodice at 4 mm reduced the waist projection slightly, but side views still show an abrupt hard shelf at the attachment; the transition remains detached-looking.
Crouch and sit retain large rigid panel overlaps/intersections and uneven hanging; prone shows broad hip/hem lobes. Pose response remains visually incoherent.

nextAction: Keep REJECT. V128 aligned the waist-band and upper-skirt clearance to the bodice clearance (10 mm to 4 mm); this reduced the ledge slightly but did not resolve it. Next geometry pass should replace the abrupt attachment/profile transition and make the sewn pleat valleys readable at product scale. Preserve pose coverage and re-inspect all five views and six poses. Fit, cloth calibration, shape keys, Unity/VRChat execution, packaging and release remain unapproved.
